claims.exact_statement: Under the uniform-cube Walsh normalization in CONVENTIONS.json, the sign/indicator, bit/nat, total/directional influence, variance/empty-atom, and character-multiplication mappings hold exactly, including D(f)=sum_i min(I_i(f),1-I_i(f)).

For every Boolean f and every coordinate i, Delta_i H(f)-L_i(f) <= (3/ln 2) I_i(f), with the two summands E_i-L_i <= I_i/ln 2 and J_i <= 2 I_i/ln 2; all three constants are simultaneously asymptotically sharp at the selector coordinate of the bent-one-point-flip Boolean family.
hypotheses: A003 definitions of E_i, L_i, J_i and Delta_i H
proof_dependencies: existence of bent Boolean functions in every even dimension
refutes: Any universal fixed-coordinate improvement replacing 1/ln2, 2/ln2, or 3/ln2 by a smaller constant
claims.first_unproved_line: Whether there exists c<3/ln2 such that min_{i:I_i>0} Delta_iH/I_i <= L/I+c for every nonconstant Boolean f.
